atoms.a: Dear Bampi, I hope that you are well. Today we went on a class trip to the zoo. We saw lots of different animals such as lions and tigers. Have you ever seen a lion?  We all bought ice cream cones from the small shop. I had a strawberry flavoured ice cream cone, it was very tasty. Do you remember when we went to get ice cream at the beach? That was an excellent day. All my love, Kofi
atoms.b:
Dear Bampi,
I hope that you are well((.))
Today we went on a class trip to the zoo((.)) We saw lots of different animals such as lions and tigers((.)) Have you ever seen a lion((?)) We all bought ice cream cones from the small shop((.)) I had a strawberry flavoured ice cream cone, it was very tasty((.)) Do you remember when we went to get ice cream at the beach((?)) That was an excellent day ((.))
All my love,
Kofi

instruction.text: Drag the punctuation to the correct places in the letter.

atoms.a: To whom it may concern, I am writing to you to express an interest in the barista position advertised in your shop window. I have over 5 years’ experience of working within the coffee industry and would love the opportunity to work for such a brilliant company. I must ask, how many hours a week of availability will be required? What is the starting wage? I look forward to hearing from you, Kind regards, Mukesh.
atoms.b:

I must ask, how many hours a week of availability will be required((?)) What is the starting wage((?))
I look forward to hearing from you((.))
Kind regards,
Mukesh
